name: Thiafentanil
summary: Thiafentanil (A-3080, Thianil) is a highly potent opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl, and was invented in 1986. Its analgesic potency is slightly less than that of carfentanil, though with a faster onset of effects, shorter duration of action and a slightly lesser tendency to produce respiratory depression.

uses.text: It is used in veterinary medicine to anesthetise animals such as impala, usually in combination with other anesthetics such as ketamine, xylazine or medetomidine to reduce the prevalence of side effects such as muscle rigidity.

sideEffects.text: It is used in veterinary medicine to anesthetise animals such as impala, usually in combination with other anesthetics such as ketamine, xylazine or medetomidine to reduce the prevalence of side effects such as muscle rigidity.

pharmacology.en: It is an extremely potent agonist at the mu opioid receptor, causing deep sedation, immobility and pain relief. In people, even a tiny amount could cause fatal breathing problems.
pharmacology.zh: 它是極強效的μ鴉片受體促效劑，會造成深度鎮靜、無法動彈與止痛。對人類而言，即使極微量也可能造成致命的呼吸問題。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是极强效的μ鸦片受体促效剂，会造成深度镇静、无法动弹与止痛。对人类而言，即使极微量也可能造成致命的呼吸问题。

fact.en: It was invented in 1986 and is used by vets to immobilise large wild animals such as antelope with a dart, after which a reversal drug is given to wake them.
fact.zh: Thiafentanil在1986年發明，獸醫用它以麻醉鏢讓羚羊等大型野生動物無法動彈，之後再給予逆轉藥物讓牠們甦醒。
fact.zhHans: Thiafentanil在1986年发明，兽医用它以麻醉镖让羚羊等大型野生动物无法动弹，之后再给予逆转药物让牠们苏醒。
